name: Gehl Food & Beverage - Southeast
old_description: Gehl Food & Beverage is located in Walterboro, South Carolina.
about:
Gehl Food & Beverage operates a 100,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Walterboro, South Carolina, at 181 Crescent Way. The site functions as the company's southeastern headquarters and production base, positioned to expand product capabilities toward the East Coast.

The plant currently runs two aseptic production lines dedicated to 1-liter Tetra Slim carton filling. Those lines support nutritional beverages, broth and stock, and plant-based beverage production. The building includes space for additional lines, with expansion planned for 2023 to accommodate growing demand in those categories.

The operation serves the food and beverage sector, specifically brands seeking aseptic co-packing in the Tetra Slim format for nutritional drinks, broths and stocks, and plant-based beverages. The facility's East Coast location is intended to shorten supply chains for customers in that region.

Gehl highlights its scalable aseptic capacity and strategic East Coast footprint as key advantages for partners looking to reach eastern U.S. markets without adding their own capital-intensive lines.
